caseNameFull: NORWEST BANK WORTHINGTON v. James R. AHLERS, et ux.

opinions.text: The motion of respondents for leave to proceed further herein in for-ma pauperis is granted. The motion of petitioners to dispense with printing the joint appendix is granted. The motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument is denied.
